notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.02
notes.content:
Enemies

 Spiders now wander around whe they don't see a player


Polish

 Enemies now turn their heads to face you when they see you
 Added sound effects for the following events:

 Spider footsteps
 Lever Toggled 


 
Misc.

 Removed the "New Game" button from the main menu


Bug Fixes

 Enemies now spawn again (whoops)
 Ork Shamans now flee the player properly (again)
 The pixelate filter is now properly applied to projectiles and other VFX

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.01
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes

 Removed Sprinting
 Removed Jumping
 Movement Speed decreased


Enemies

 Greatly improved enemy AI
 Added bosses to the end of every dungeon (Still WIP)


Audio

 Added reverb to most sounds so make the environment feel more realistic.
 Added sound effects for the following events:

 Opening a chest
 Player Footsteps
 Ork Footsteps
 Spending gold
 Gaining gold
 Spending Arcrelium
 Gaining Arcrelium


 
Misc.

 Changed the chest model to fit the rest of the game better.


Bug Fixes

 You respawn at full health now, instead of keeping some of the damage you took before you died.
 You now lose your boons and gold when you die.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.3.02
notes.content:
Dungeon

 The boss room now has a locked door. To open it, you need to find the lever somewhere in the dungeon.
 At least one room of each type will spawn in the dungeon, instead of being entirely random. (This is because some specific dungeon elements require certain rooms to exist, and this just makes it easier to implement.)


Weapons

 Adjusted the stats on some weapons to feel better to use.


Infusions

 The neckbeard now gives you infusion items instead of unlocking weapons. 


Bug Fixes

 The squished bookshelf is no longer squished.
 No longer displays an empty interact popup when you look at an object you've already interacted with.
 The neckbeard no longer turns you away if you try to barter with him without the gold he asks for.
 The Boss Room no longer sometimes spawns without an entrance, leaving you trapped in the dungeon.
 Your weapon no longer gets farther and farther away from your hand each time you switch weapons.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.3.01
notes.content:
Infusion
- Unblocked the sealed doorway in the lobby. It looks like there was a room hidden behind...
- Weapons can now be infused, upgrading them and unlocking special abilities.

Polish
- Weapons now play sounds when you attack with them.
- Changed the way you hold weapons so they now don't interfere with your vision.
- Modified the VFX so that torches aren't blindingly bright.

Weapons
- Removed the Secondary Weapon. It will now be a slot for equipment.
- Added New Weapon: Ignis


Trinkets:
- Added two new Trinkets*:
    - Speed on Kill
    - Damage Resistance on Kill
    * These are a work in progress.


Quality of Life
- Conditions affecting you are now displayed above the health bar. These still (mostly) don't have images, this is still WIP.

Debug
- Added debug commands

Bug Fixes
- The sword in Bruce's room no longer points directly up instead of resting on the weapon rack.
- Fixed a bug where the Ork Shaman would run towards you backwards instead of away from you when you got too close.
- Healing now updates your health display properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.2.06
notes.content:
Quality of Life
- Added a button to return to the main menu
- Achievements now unlock instantly when completed.

Bug Fixes
- Dungeon entrance will no longer vanish if you die in the dungeon.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.2.05
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Bruce's questing menu no longer crashes the game when you opened it.
- Bruce no longer only offers you quest rewards that you already owned instead of ones you didn't own.
- Ork Brutes no longer move too slow and attack at the wrong distance.
- Some players were unable to play the game after clicking "New Game." This is now fixed.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.2.04
notes.content:
Trinkets
- Trinkets can appear on the ground and be picked up to unlock them.
- Arcrellium Crystals can be found on the ground in the same way as Trinkets.
- Improved the Trinket selection menu to make it more clear what trinket is selected. Still a WIP.

Quests
- Bruce now offers Quests for the player to complete.

Dungeon
- Prisoners can be found in the dungeon, and you can trade with them to unlock new weapons.
- Added new enemy type: Spiders!
 - This is the current replacement for Arachnids. Will be expanded on more in the future.

VFX
- Changed the way the player's light works, to hopefully make it more clear.
- Added multiple post-processing effects. Looking for feedback on how it looks!

Quality of Life Changes
- Pressing Escape while paused now unpauses.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.2.03
notes.content:
Dungeon
- Decreased spawn chance of mushrooms (80% -> 60%)
- Removed Arachnids from spawning (for now).
- Boss Rooms are updated to have better lighting.

VFX:
- Added a dithering effect to post-processing to replace the pixelation. Theoretically, this should be better than a low-resolution form of pixelation. Looking for feedback.


Bug Fixes
- Certain parts of the UI will no longer be cut off on certain resolutions.
- Made it impossible to get around the corner while jumping into the lava in the lobby. (You can still stay alive by constantly jumping down there though, good luck to anyone who wants to try.)
- Pressing interact no longer triggers the last interactable object you looked at.
- When a player dies, it no longer disables that player's audio for the rest of the game.
- You can no longer be offered boons that shouldn't be offered.
- Prison rooms are able to spawn in the dungeon again.
- You are no longer able to enter the dungeon or exit the dungeon unless all players are within the exit room.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.2.02
notes.content:
VFX
- No longer low resolution VFX. Looking into oth post-processessing effects.

Boss Room
- Boss Rooms now spawn at the end of each dungeon
- Currently no bosses in the game. In the boss room, if there is a player who has not found Bruce, they will find Bruce.

Bug Fixes:
- Dungeon is no longer spawned only for the host during mulitplayer games
- Dungeon no longer spawns the entrance or exit in unreachable positions
- Loot Orbs no longer give multiple boons.
- Dungeon Chests no longer give multiple loot orbs.
- Lava now kills you (You're welcome, Owen.)

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.2.01
notes.content:
Added Boons and Trinkets!

Boons:
- When you open a chest, choose one of three boons to get. 
- Boons only last until the end of a run.

Trinkets:
- You can have one trinket equipped at a time. 
- Trinkets last between runs.
- Currently all trinkets are unlocked by default, no way to unlock others.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.11
notes.content:
Chests
- No Longer grant achievements that unlock items (Currently no way to get the achievements)
- Not grant "Loot Orbs" that give a random boon (Will be changed to a selection from 3 in the future)

Enemies
- Added the Arachnid enemy
- Currently, the Arachnid spawn way too much and don't do anything except walk towards you (sometimes.) I'll get around to fixing them

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.10
notes.content:
Added sound when the player and enemies are hit, as well as a white flash for enemies.

Added more weapons.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.1.09
notes.content:
Settings now save when you exit the game
 Added a few new weapons:


 Axe
 Hatchet
 Mace
 Halberd
